nodes.label: PKA_ environment configuration
nodes.rationale: The backend accepts no DSN/URL env var for PostgreSQL — always separate PKA_DATABASE_* parameters, with the password only ever supplied via PKA_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE, never as a variable, command, or logged value.

nodes.label: Approval token security (one-time 256-bit)
nodes.rationale: Only the SHA-256 of the decision token is persisted; approve/reject/revise hash the input, do constant-time comparison, apply optimistic version control, then remove the consumed fingerprint — all inside the same transaction as the audit write.

nodes.label: POST /api/mcp/reads (read-only MCP endpoint)
nodes.rationale: Refuses before any network access: disabled provider/binding, unregistered tool, any action class other than READ, out-of-schema arguments (cloudId/fileKey/nodeId), or a live schema hash mismatch against the approved registry fingerprint.
